scope: Theorem 5.1 (Compatible boundaries and radial caps) of the manuscript “Finite angular cylinder covers below the half-area bound” (preprints/Finite-angular-cylinder-covers-below-the-half-area-bound-September-27-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 100 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 edbcf76e6573c125), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let τ > 0 tend to zero through any set accumulating at zero. For each τ, choose a finite partition −1 = q0 < · · · < qm = 1, constants αj, βj, and positive continuous functions Rj on Ij = [qj−1, qj]. Suppose that L(q) = αj − qβj is continuous on [−1, 1] and L(−1) = L(1) = 0. Suppose also, uniformly for every j and q ∈ Ij, that βj = q/2 + O(τ2 ), αj = (1 + q2 )/4 + O(τ2 ), (5.1) Rj(q) = 1 2 + τ2 d(q) + η  + O(τ4 ), 0 < η < 1/480. (5.2) Here η is fixed, and all error constants and their common range of validity are independent of τ, j, q. Define P− j = {(0, qS, HS) : q ∈ Ij, 0 ≤ S ≤ Rj(q)}, v− j = (1, ταj, Hτβj), P+ j = {(qT, 0, H(1 − T)) : q ∈ Ij, 0 ≤ T ≤ Rj(q)}, v+ j = (−ταj, 1, Hτβj). For every sufficiently small admissible τ, the 2m cylinders P− j + Rv− j and P+ j + Rv+ j cover the closed tetrahedron K. Their bases are compact, and their total area Cτ satisfies Cτ H = 1 2 +  2η − 1 240  τ2 + O(τ4 ). (5.3) If each Rj is constant, every base is a triangle. The threshold and error constant may depend on η and the uniform constants in the hypotheses, but not on m.
